invariants.rationale: fileName should be non-null and non-empty to successfully load a TiledMap.
If the method returns normally, a TiledMap object should be returned, not null.
The method is expected to return an object of type TiledMap.
The method is intended to load files with .tmx or .tmj extension as per the Javadoc.
If the file extension is not supported, result may be null due to an exception being thrown.
